description: caseworker hooks. (1) PreToolUse Bash|PowerShell: git commit / git push are judged against the branch state JSON (gate + review records) — both shell tools, because matching only one leaves the other unguarded. (2) PreToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit: files matching harness.json.protected[] cannot be edited (verification assets, gate scripts). (3) Stop: when a completeness loop is active for this session (.loop/session.local.json), the stop is blocked and the next round prompt is fed back; verdict comes from loop.mjs on disk.
